description: Opt-in guards on git commit, git add, git push and gh pr, an opt-in refusal of a subagent call that would silently inherit the session's model, an opt-in check that an email draft opens with the greeting for the time of day, an opt-in restart of idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code, and an opt-in budget mode that routes work to cheaper models while the usage allowance burns too fast. The hooks module checks the main thread's git commands; the Bash PreToolUse hook checks subagents' and every call when the module did not load. Each is off until switched on in /config; a hook whose options are all off does not start python3.

hooks.command: for on in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_ATTRIBUTION_TRAILERS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_COMMITS_MD" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_WARN_MAIN_CHECKOUT_COMMIT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_SECRETS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_LONG_BODIES"; do case "$on" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git_guards.py" ;; esac; done
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_REQUIRE_SUBAGENT_MODEL" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/model_guard.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BUDGET_MODE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/budget.py" agent ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_EMAIL_GREETING" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/email_greeting.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BUDGET_MODE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/budget.py" prompt ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BUDGET_MODE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/budget.py" session ;; esac
